description: YHSwellSeal is a 1-part polyurethane hydrophilic sealant which swells in contact with water to seal all types of construction joints and penetrations in concrete structures. It is used to adhere the YHSwellbar profiles to the structure.
whereToUse: Construction joints in water retaining or excluding structures such as water tanks, swimming pools, pumping chambers, reservoirs, tunnels, basement, culverts, cable ducts etc.
Pipe and steel work penetrations through concrete floors and walls
Joints between floor slabs and pile caps
advantages: Versatile solution for joints and details
notFor: Rough surfaces are susceptible to leaking
The minimum cover to the sealant on both sides shall be 8 cm for reinforced concrete and 15 cm for unreinforced concrete

Allow YHSwellSeal to harden for a minimum of 12 hours prior to concrete placement. For concrete pouring height greater than 50 cm, the YHSwellSeal shall harden for at least 24 hours before concrete placement
Protect uncured YHSwellSeal from water exposure (e.g. rain) until concrete placement is completed
Profile installation shall be completed within a maximum of 30 minutes at an ambient condition of +23 °C / 50 % r.h.
